title: The Parity of Invariant Characteristics
summary: We demonstrate a method to prove that a theta characteristic on Riemann surface $S$ invariant under the action of $G \leq \mathrm{Aut}(S)$ has even parity by considering the representation theory of the double cover $\tilde{G} = 2 \cdot G$. We apply this to certain Hurwitz curves, and prove a recent conjecture of Broughton \& Disney-Hogg.
